title: Enterprise deployment request routing and network dependency assessment
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Problem: We receive a steady stream of enterprise requests for Private/VPC/on-prem deployments that have widely varying network and upgrade constraints. Current intake is manual, inconsistent, and causes long lead times for both sales and engineering. Goal: Define a repeatable routing and dependency-assessment flow that (1) automatically classifies incoming requests by network/air-gap/upgrade complexity, (2) maps to a priority bucket and standard response, and (3) outputs a deterministic engineering intake packet so SRE/infra can estimate effort quickly.
approach: 1) Design a lightweight taxonomy for networking constraints (e.g., full air-gap, egress-controlled VPC, proxy-only egress, intermittent connectivity) and upgrade constraints (windows, change freeze, validated images). 2) Create an intake form template and scoring rubric that the AE/CS team uses to collect fields required for deterministic triage. 3) Define routing rules that map scores to: auto-approve for onboarding runbook, schedule engineering preflight, or escalate to solutions engineering. 4) Ship an initial reference template (Confluence) + canned response emails + an intake API endpoint for automated scoring.
non_goals: This ticket does not implement the intake UI in the Console or enforce SLAs for Dedicated capacity. It is focused on the triage flow, artifacts, and routing rules; engineering work to implement automations will be separate epics.
acceptance_criteria: A scored intake schema (JSON) is approved by PM, Solutions Eng, and Security
Routing rules documented and mapped to next-action (onboard-runbook / schedule-preflight / escalate)
Reference Confluence page with sample filled intake cases (3 examples: low, medium, high complexity)
Canned email templates for AE/CS with expected timelines and checklist links
Hand-off packet template for engineering that includes required logs, network topology, and upgrade constraints
